description: SetErrorType is #[non_exhaustive] and has a Display impl with an exhaustive match and no wildcard arm. Adding a new variant (the expected use of #[non_exhaustive]) will cause a compile error in the Display impl, requiring two simultaneous edits. Contributors adding a new error type will encounter this friction on every addition. A _ => fallback or a macro-derived Display would be safer.
title: SetErrorType Display impl will fail to compile on new variant
